steps: A schema1 document opens in free planar mode. No-change Check preserves every author byte and creates no Apply ticket.
Explicit gravity/jump mode selects and locks slide, reviews schema3 and the three motion values, and preserves shape, offset, IDs, layer spelling, BOM, escaped key and line endings without writing.
Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve focused mode and exact review, with reachable numeric controls and Check/Apply/Cancel and no horizontal overflow.

Apply updates only the ordinary source draft. Save writes only the reviewed physics document. Reopen retains motion; disabling reviews removal without lowering schema or changing slide, and Cancel preserves the saved file.

Real browser plan → Godot 0.24.0 build → finite headless run exposes 30 validated motion samples. A native grounded jump rises then lands; the floor sweep shows requested/actual displacement, collider, point and upward normal.
Instance filtering, visit/step filtering and previous/next selection operate on the same admitted records without running commands or changing actor positions.
Collider and character actions independently navigate to their exact /bodies/N source ranges in the same saved physics document.
Source navigation and observation filtering preserve the completed job, runtime snapshot and all author bytes after the one explicit physics Save.
